pasos.eval: (() => { const d = document.getElementById('gtf-matricial-marco')?.contentDocument; if (!d) return 'sin marco'; const h = d.documentElement.outerHTML; return JSON.stringify({ hojas: d.querySelectorAll('.hoja').length, valores: d.querySelectorAll('.v').length, marcas: d.querySelectorAll('[data-marca-copia]').length, celeste: h.includes('#16759f'), negro: h.includes('#000000') }); })()
(() => { const c = [...document.querySelectorAll('input[aria-label^="Elegir la guía"]')].slice(0, 2); c.forEach((i) => i.click()); return c.map((i) => i.getAttribute('aria-label')).join(' | '); })()
(() => { const html = document.getElementById('gtf-matricial-marco').srcdoc; document.open(); document.write(html); document.close(); return html.length; })()
